source_note: Gap fill 2026-11-12: Q3 2026 column added from the company unaudited third quarter accounts filed with the NGX on 21 October 2026. Revenue 403,333,700 less cost of sales 251,953,411 equals the printed gross profit of 151,380,289, and profit before tax 61,651,943 less tax 20,961,869 equals the printed profit of 40,690,074. | earlier note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47517_GUINNESS_NIG_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. | AUDIT 2026-10-04 (net-profit accuracy): the H1 2026 net profit was WITHHELD (set to null). This statement is stored in NGN '000 (the filing's printed unit), not absolute units, so the value renders 1000x too small under the platform's absolute convention. The audit rule requires the cell to equal the discovery record's profit_after_tax with the unit applied (absolute 25301636000); per fix-only-by-withholding it was nulled rather than rescaled. NOTE: the whole statement (revenue and every other row of this file) is stored in NGN '000 and needs block normalisation.
marketCapSource: NGX 'List of Equities as of 2026-04-09' (doclib.ngxgroup.com), shares outstanding

unitNormalised.basis: market-cap anchored: cap 8.42859e+11, net profit 4.11627e+07, revenue 7.30808e+08; at x1000 P/E 20.48, P/S 1.153

periodAlignment.note: this statement and its counterpart cover different periods; pair them by period label, never by array index (see bot/statements.py::pkey)

reconciliation_note: The figure is corroborated by the statement's own bridge and is shown unchanged.
periodOrder: repaired 2026-10-04: periods were not newest-first; reordered so periods[0] is the newest period and every value stays on its own period label
periods_note: FY2025 is the audited 18-month period from 1 July 2024 to 31 December 2025, the transition period after Guinness Nigeria changed its financial year end to 31 December (revenue 730 803 355, gross profit 230 481 949, profit after tax 41 162 700). FY2024 is the 12 months ended 30 June 2024 (revenue 299 489 774). H1 2026 is the six months ended 30 June 2026 (revenue 265 042 881). The 18-month column is not comparable with either 12-month column.
